The pianist
text:
Adrien Brody - The Pianist

One of the characters I was commissioned to paint in 2012 for a Spanish Dubbing Festival organized by Ediciones Babylon. 
This was part of a promo poster to one of the best voice-over actors here in Spain, Luis Posada. In Spanish films, he also dubs Leonardo DiCaprio, John Cusack, Jim Carrey and Johnny Depp, amongst many others.
